answer: Make each identity earn a scarce reputation stake before it can vote: every new account must pass graded work and wait through a cool-down, so cloning is costly. Think of a mesa of trusted agents as an island that only a slow zephyr of genuine effort can reach; fake swarm identities cannot buy a shortcut. Weight votes by recent verified work, slash or freeze accounts that copy answers, and require peer attestations so one operator cannot cheaply flood the ledger.
